The package detector already has several ad hoc skip branches; I’m consolidating those checks into the requested eligibility function and will base Trivy reuse on `ScannedBy`.

item.text: The parser now takes the artifact name as `ServerName`, adds `:latest` for untagged container images, copies the OS name into `Release`, and leaves `Optional` nil. Package CVE checks now skip Trivy results and unsupported/incomplete OS metadata with a logged reason; OVAL/GOST errors are logged and returned. I’m formatting and checking the existing parser and detector tests next.

item.text:
Implemented Trivy OS version extraction, artifact-based server names with `:latest` for untagged container images, and nil `Optional` metadata. Package CVE detection now skips Trivy scans and unsupported or incomplete OS results, logging the reason; OVAL/GOST errors are logged and returned. Trivy scan reuse now checks `ScannedBy`.

Updated parser expectations and recorded progress in `.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md`.

Verification passed: `go test ./contrib/trivy/parser/v2 ./detector` and `git diff --check`.
